## Review checklist

- [ ] Roadmap row has the right owner/status, or a maintainer agreed this small docs fix.
- [ ] Behavior changes have a regression test; docs-only changes have the docs checks.
- [ ] Changed runtime files were vendored; generated policy/agent files are consistent.
- [ ] README/guide claims describe working behavior or name a planned roadmap row.
- [ ] No secrets, private plans, employer material or unredacted output included.
- [ ] Core stays standard-library-only; outward actions cannot become plainly allowed.
- [ ] Changelog/docs updated when behavior or user instructions changed.
